messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Aquila Systems (dedicated pool aq-pool-3) - elevated 5xx rate detected across frontend router. Trigger: error-rate > 3% for 3m. Severity P2. Paging on-call: @sara @matt

sara: On it. Jumping in to triage. Do we have a customer impact calc yet?

matt: Looking at logs now — a lot of 'BackendTimeoutError' against model endpoint aq-bert-v1, spikes at 10:12-10:18 UTC. Could be a noisy tenant or kernel regressions after last quantization rollout.

kevin: I can pull pool metrics. If it's a noisy tenant we should isolate before evicting capacity.

matt: Copy. Sending top offenders by request_id and tenant tag.

```# top noisy tenants (by reqs/min)
tenant: aquila-search | 420 r/m | p95 latency 850ms
tenant: unknown-143    | 380 r/m | p95 latency 1200ms
tenant: livestream-7   | 50 r/m  | p95 latency 2200ms
```

emily: Customer impact summary from telemetry: 4.3% of Aquila's requests returned 5xx; global error budget still fine but customer SLA window at risk. They have production traffic in eu-west.

sara: Plan: 1) throttle unknown-143 to 50 r/m 2) move aquila-search to fallback pool aq-pool-3b (warm spare) 3) enable request-level retries with jitter for non-idempotent calls. Can someone run the failover?

kevin: Kicking off migration to aq-pool-3b now. ETA ~3m. Command: `redwoodctl migrate --tenant aquila-search --from aq-pool-3 --to aq-pool-3b --grace 30s`

ops-bot: Migration job started (job id mig-1789-01). Live metrics will update in ~120s.

matt: Applied throttling rule for unknown-143: `policy:set rate-limit tenant=unknown-143 rate=50/m`

sara: Good. Can CS reach out to Aquila and warn them about short failover? Jordan, can you prep a quick one-line heads-up for their platform ops?

jordan: On it. Drafting: "We detected elevated 5xx rates impacting some requests. We're routing traffic to a warm spare pool and applying a temporary throttle to one noisy tenant; services should be recovering now. We'll follow up with an RCA." Will ping once sent.

matt: Metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 4.3% -> 1.2% over last 2m. p95 latency for aquila-search down to 320ms.

sara: Nice. Keep monitoring for 10m window. If error rate stabilizes <1% for 10m, we'll move to post-incident mode.

kevin: Noted — capturing heap/kv stats for the affected nodes in case we need to repro.

emily: Customer impact calc (prelim): ~7k requests failed over 15 minutes. Estimated customer API error time windows: 00:10-00:25 UTC on eu-west. Suggest credit: small SLA trigger; recommend 10% monthly credit on affected route unless RCA shows customer misconfig.

sara: Flag for post-incident: check last night's quantization rollout on aq-bert-v1. If the rollout touched kernel selection this could be correlated. Assign to eng-ml for deeper root cause.

matt: I pushed a rollback for the latest runtime kernels on the affected nodes as a precaution: `runtimectl rollback --nodes pool-aq-3-n[12-14] --version v2026-03-10`. No impact yet, keeping until we confirm.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigating -> Post-incident monitoring. Duration: 15m.

jordan: Sent customer heads-up via support channel. Customer acknowledged, asked for ETA on full RCA and whether any data loss. I told them no data loss observed and an RCA & exec summary will follow within 48h.

kevin: Captured histograms and KV cache hit rates and uploaded to incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/1789001234/metrics.tar.gz

emily: Creating an RCA draft now. Will include timeline, mitigation actions (throttle + failover), telemetry, suggested credit (10%), and action items: canary quantization rollouts, improved noisy-tenant detection, add automated tenant isolation.

sara: Add an exec summary paragraph for the customer leadership: 2-3 sentences, non-technical. Jordan to review before send.

jordan: Will review. Also recommend offering a short 1:1 bridge with our SRE lead if they want live walkthrough.

matt: Quick note for oncall handoff: If errors reappear, immediately run `redwoodctl isolate-tenant --tenant unknown-143 --pool aq-pool-3` to prevent cross-tenant impact.

sara: Agreed. I'm handing off active monitoring to @kevin for the next shift. Leaving this thread in post-incident watch.

kevin: Taking handoff. I'll leave detailed notes in the incident ticket and tag eng-ml + runtime for RCA deep dive.

emily: RCA draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Aqila-RCA-draft (internal). Will drop final version and executive brief in 24-48h.

jordan: Final customer note to send after RCA: short apology, timeline of impact, mitigation steps taken, the credit offer (10% for affected route), and an invite for 1:1.

sara: Thanks team. :thumbsup: Closing live mitigation. Monitoring window started 10:25 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident closed (automated): severity downgraded to advisory. Ticket: INC-1789-01.
